Approached back half of kennel with a relaxed body.  Offered treats then presented leash.  Dog would become whale eyed, lowered head & became still bodied.  Slowly leashed dog. Dog would eat treats then jump up onto handler while handler was sitting on bench.  Tossed more treats away to help direct dog away.  Dog ate treats then turned & jumped up, biting @ handlers treat pouch & pulling back while making a grumbling sound.  Handler quickly stood up & side stepped, dog would release treat pouch from mouth then handler dropped more treats away from body.  Dog would eat treats then turn body & continue to jump high towards handlers face while air snapping, handler would quickly shift head back & step to the side each time.  Scattered more treats then reached to pick up leash while dog would be eating treats.  Dog would flip head back once leash was in hand & adjusting leash stopper.  Walked dog around in PY.  Would do an intense skin crawling when being pet on side of body.  Scattered more treats then attached clip leash while dog would be distracted with treats.  Walked back to kennel with a strong pull on leash.  Removed leash with use of clip leash.
